name: Mushroom Town
terrain_style: grassySoil tileset (layers 0 and 1): green grass fringe over olive/khaki-brown cobbled dirt (per minimap; the maplestory.io render of this map shows no tiles). Same sky backdrop set as map 0 (grassySoil back 0-3,6).

landmarks.what: Green hedge bushes forming the base of Roger's terrace
Vegetable garden fence (posts, rope, leafy crops) on top of Roger's terrace
Yellow mushroom house with brown-striped cap (houseGS/house8 body)
Arched doorway with keyhole plank door (house8 deco + door/13)
Barrel chimney with little yellow hat (house/chimney/0)
Vegetable garden fence in front of the house

notes: Portals recovered from raw WZ because the parsed API JSON has null entries: https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000010000.img/portal/<n> (fields pn, pt, tm, tn, x, y). All portals here are therefore sourced, not inferred.

Landmark x,y are WZ obj anchors from https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Map/Map0/000010000.img/<layer>/obj/<n>; sprites identified via https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Map/Obj/<oS>.img/<l0>/<l1>/<l2>/0. API-reported sprite origins were all exactly (w/2,h/2), so treat anchors as roughly sprite-centre; footprints are +-half sprite size. Where one landmark merges several objects, x,y is their approximate mean.
tiers[].y_left/y_right are MapleStory y (down is positive). Tier ids are local to this file. Ladders: y1 = top end, y2 = bottom end (raw data order); from_tier = bottom tier, to_tier = top tier.
v8 has zero mob spawns in this map (life contains only NPCs).
Spawn point "sp" at (-91,181), above T1 near the sunflowers.
in00 (pt 1, tm 999999999) is an arrival-only point: there is no portal back to map 0.
T4 (Roger) is 150 px above T3 with walls at x=186 and x=444 down to y=210 and no ladder; it is layer 0 while T1-T3 are layer 1.
